description: Open start times for a service or package at a branch, for one day or up to 7 consecutive days, with any professional or a chosen one. Times are local to the branch. These are the times the business's booking website offers; they are not held.

branch.description: Branch id or name. Required when the business has more than one branch.
branch.title: Branch

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

date.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD, in the branch's local calendar. Defaults to today.
date.title: Date

end_date.description: Last day to search (inclusive), at most 6 days after date. Defaults to date.
end_date.title: End Date

option.description: Option id or name, required when the service has options.
option.title: Option

package.description: Package id or name, instead of service.
package.title: Package

service.description: Service id or name. Give this or package.
service.title: Service

staff.description: Professional's staff id or name. Omit for any professional.
staff.title: Staff

name: find_available_times
title: Available times
